descriptions.w3d_char_to_lower: Converts a character to lower case when the character class table marks it as upper case.
descriptions.w3d_service_request_8034127c: Forwards two arguments to a request routine on a service object held by a global holder.
descriptions.w3d_vector_clear_8034134c: Pops every pointer from the end of a pointer vector and frees each one until the vector is empty.
descriptions.w3d_range_limits_reset: Resets a limits record: two indices to -1, three limits to 32767, and a flag and value to zero.
descriptions.w3d_vector_destroy_virtual16: Empties a pointer vector from the end, destroying each non-null object through its virtual destructor.
descriptions.w3d_vector_destroy_virtual12: Empties a pointer vector from the end, destroying each non-null object through a virtual destructor slot.
descriptions.w3d_vector_destroy_named: Empties a vector of named entries, releasing each entry's string and freeing the entry.
